title: Tool: fee calculator
question: Where should the fee calculator show its result?

options.label: Beside the inputs
options.description: Inputs on the left, live result on the right. Best on wide screens.

options.label: Below the inputs
options.description: Inputs stacked above a result card. Same order as on a phone.

options.label: Pinned result bar
options.description: A bar fixed to the bottom of the screen that updates as you type.

content: Merchants enter volume, average order value and plan, and see the monthly fee. They change one input at a time and watch the number move.
